---

title: "Skill Gap Analysis"
subtitle: "Market Skill Demand and Career Readiness"
---

## Overview

This section connects the market skill demand identified in the exploratory analysis to the current skill profile. The goal is to identify which skills are already aligned with AI-related job demand and which areas need further development.

## Market Skill Demand

Based on our Lightcast job posting analysis, the most common skills in AI-related postings include SQL, Python, Data Analysis, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Tableau, Statistics, Communication, AWS, Azure, Business Intelligence, Power BI, Data Visualization, and Data Modeling.

These results show that AI-related careers are not only about AI model development. Many roles also require data handling, programming, cloud tools, visualization, and communication skills.

## Current Skill Profile

The table below uses a 1-5 self-assessment scale, where 1 means limited confidence and 5 means strong confidence.

| Skill              | Self-Assessment Score |
| ------------------ | --------------------: |
| Python             |                     3 |
| SQL                |                     3 |
| Machine Learning   |                     2 |
| AI                 |                     2 |
| Data Analysis      |                     3 |
| Data Visualization |                     3 |
| AWS                |                     1 |
| Azure              |                     1 |
| Communication      |                     4 |

## Skill Gap Interpretation

The largest gaps are in cloud platforms and machine learning. AWS and Azure appear in AI-related job postings, but the current self-assessment scores for these areas remain low. Machine Learning and AI are also important because they directly connect to the project topic.

Stronger areas include communication, SQL, Python, data analysis, and data visualization. These skills provide a foundation for business analytics roles, especially roles that require turning technical results into clear business insights.

## Career Strategy

For career preparation, the main priority is strengthening skills in Python, SQL, machine learning, and cloud computing. Tableau and Power BI should also remain important, since AI-related roles still require clear business reporting and visualization.

A stronger portfolio would combine job market data, machine learning, and dashboard reporting. This connects directly to the type of work shown in our project and helps translate the skill gap analysis into a practical career strategy.
